name: Eternal Survival
storyline:
Explore the forgotten depths of the kingdom of Menegroth, the tainted lands overrun by the undead since the discovery of necromancy.

Centuries ago, a war was waged by Menegroth, the kingdom of the necromancer king Tuliph. The kingdom conquered territory and devastated the borders, but was ultimately defeated. At the end of the war, its outer borders were sealed by a great wall of bones, and its interior was overtaken by hordes of undead and necromancers.

You are a fearless adventurer who dares to challenge the cursed depths of Menegroth, facing endless waves of undead in search of fame, treasure, and the secrets of the feared necromancer generals of Menegroth.

Eternity awaits those who dare to face the darkness… Will you survive?
summary: Eternal Survival is a Horde Survival game, where you enter and level up taking power and destroying enemies, collecting gold to buy more passive power to your character and can participate on hardest runs
